The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace and a lighter-colored head with distinct markings. Its limbs are visible, showing webbed feet and claws. The background is blurred green foliage.

The tail is located at the posterior end of the turtle and is completely occluded by the angle of the photo and the position of the hind leg/shell.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral/functional trait that cannot be verified from a static image where the turtle is simply being held. The anatomy suggests it, but the 'ability' is not testable visually here.
